ideas.title: Investigating ICE Shootings
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into recent ICE shootings, including the fatal shooting of Silverio Villegas-Gonzalez.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding recent ICE shootings?
What measures are being taken to increase accountability within ICE?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the recent ICE shootings and examine the need for increased accountability and oversight within the agency.

ideas.title: Exposing Child Sex Trafficking
ideas.description: An investigation into child sex trafficking, including the recent arrest of a state senator's chief of staff.
ideas.angle: The scope and scale of child sex trafficking
questions: What is the scope and scale of child sex trafficking?
What measures are being taken to prevent and investigate child sex trafficking?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the scope and scale of child sex trafficking and examine the measures being taken to prevent and investigate these crimes.
